violation_type.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required
violation_type.typical_finding: Upon CCR's arrival the operation was using a reduced nap time ratio with only 1 caregiver present in the building and more than 13 children.

finding_variants.text: Upon CCR's arrival the operation was using a reduced nap time ratio with only 1 caregiver present in the building and more than 13 children.
There was no additional employee present in the building during naptime.
During the inspection there was a total of 19 children in the building and there was not additional employee in the building.
The only staff in the building was the person who was caring for the napping children.
Recite: The operation did not have an additional employee in the building during nap time.
There was not an additional caregiver present during nap time. The two caregivers that were present were supervising children during nap time.
